title: observability: add token/kv-level metrics, dashboard panels, and alert tuning for deduped cost/latency breakdowns
author: Priya Natarajan
description: Add token-level and KV-cache metrics to the observability pipeline, extend Grafana dashboards with dedicated panels for token-cost and per-token latency breakdowns, and tune alert thresholds to reduce noisy paging alerts. This change: 1) emits new Prometheus metrics (redwood_inference_tokens_generated_total, redwood_inference_token_latency_seconds_bucket, redwood_inference_kv_cache_hits_total, redwood_inference_kv_cache_misses_total, redwood_inference_token_cost_cents_total) instrumented at the service handler and cache layer; 2) updates the metrics exporter and scrape targets to include the dedicated serving and cache exporter endpoints; 3) adds a set of Grafana dashboard panels grouped by model, route, and customer tier showing per-token latency distribution, token cost contribution, and KV hit/miss ratios; 4) provides curated alert rules for SLO breaches and cost spikes with different severity for hosted vs dedicated customers; 5) includes doc changes (observability/metrics.md, dashboards/README) and test coverage for new metrics. Motivation: noisy alerts and lack of token-level visibility made it hard to diagnose regressions (see ENG-5421). This PR is the follow-up to the alert-tuning spike and the KV-metrics proto implemented in previous PRs and consolidates token-level cost/latency into stable dashboards and alerts. Backwards compatibility: new metrics are additive, labels follow existing naming conventions. Rollout plan: deploy metrics + exporter rollout to staging, validate dashboards with sample traffic, then enable alerts in production behind a feature flag for 48h canary before global enablement.

María: Alert thresholds look reasonable but recommend a staggered rollout (canary + 48h observation) to avoid pager storms. Approved pending canary plan in PR description.
Samir: Noted exporter TLS configuration for private deployments; asked to ensure exporter respects KMS-provided certs. Priya: added exporter tls integration tests and docs.
CI: Prometheus lint failed on first run due to duplicate rule IDs; fixed in follow-up commit and re-ran checks.
release_notes: Add token-level and KV-cache observability: new metrics, dashboards, and tuned alerts to improve cost/latency diagnostics. Rollout gated by canary.
